about: A siding to a balloon loop, off a place where a stretch shown ends. Track 0 (a to b) and 2 (c to d) are Local, joined by track 1 with no tag. Track 3 with no tag leads from b to e, where a loop with no tag (4, 5 and 6, through f and g) turns back. The loop leads nowhere else, so with no tag off it is not shown, though no end of it is a dead end, and it starts where track 1 meets a stretch shown. Each stretch is [from, to, tagged, shown, the tags on that are on].
